posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
You can listen to them all on Bandcamp as well (e.g. https://handelabra.bandcamp.com/album/sentinels-of-the-multiverse-ost-volume-1) and buy them from there or from sentinelsdigital.com, iTunes, etc.

Incidentally, losing to the Chairman by means of Unforgiving Wasteland does have a "unique" loss screen, but I believe it's the same as the "unique" win screen you get when the villain gets removed from the game by the same means.  I believe it does have unique music, though, as do the other environment loss conditions.

posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
QuirkyDM:

Losers unite! Thanks for doing that. And saving the rest of us from having to go through it all ourselves. Unlocking Dark Watch Setback was all the losses I need for this lifetime, I don't need to try to intentionally get more.

I run a website dedicated to cataloging death scenes for adventure games, so this was… marginally less difficult to do. A lot of these I lost "for real" (yes I honestly lost to Ambuscade once, like I said, ow, my dignity).

And yes, Jean-Marc's music is made of awesome. I'm always a little surprised whenever I come across people where you can tell they haven't read through the Multiverse, since that was pretty much the second thing I did after buying the app (the first was winning the tutorial).
